faq.q: What is CoverScore?
faq.a: CoverScore is a hospital risk assessment platform that analyzes 25+ risk factors across 6 key categories to generate your overall risk score.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: It takes less than 5 minutes to complete the assessment and get your risk score.

faq.q: Is my data secure?
faq.a: Yes. Your data is 100% secure and confidential. We use industry-standard encryption and never share your information.

faq.q: What do I get with my risk score?
faq.a: You'll receive a detailed risk report showing your score, risk breakdown, identified gaps, potential impact, and actionable recommendations.

faq.q: How much does it cost?
faq.a: Your risk assessment is completely free. No hidden fees. No credit card required.

faq.q: Can I speak with someone?
faq.a: Absolutely! Our team is here to help. Contact us anytime at support@coverscore.com

faq.q: What is a CoverScore Risk Assessment?
faq.a: CoverScore uses AI to analyze your business's unique risk profile across operational, safety, financial, and compliance categories — giving you a personalized score and actionable insights in minutes.

faq.q: How long does the assessment take?
faq.a: The entire process takes less than 5 minutes. You answer a few simple questions via WhatsApp, and our AI generates your full risk report instantly.

faq.q: Is my data secure and confidential?
faq.a: Absolutely. All data is encrypted end-to-end and processed securely. We never share your information with third parties.

faq.q: What happens after I get my risk score?
faq.a: You'll receive a detailed report highlighting your top risk areas and financial exposure. You can optionally speak with a business risk advisor for tailored recommendations.
